note: Both sets cover the full Table 5-1 drivetrain properties with supporting quotes and both repeat nearly every fact twice (once as a component-level claim and once as an NREL 5-MW turbine-level claim). Set A's component-level claims (rotor rated speed, generator rated speed, brake torque with 'Fully-Deployed' condition) are all supported by the page. Set B adds unsupported conditions to two of its component-level claims: 'Region 3' for the generator rated speed and 'baseline' for the rotor rated speed, neither of which appears anywhere on the page. Otherwise the two sets are near-identical in coverage and accuracy, so A is the better set.
remarks: Both extractions double-count every table row (component-level plus turbine-level claim with the same quote), inflating the sets without adding information. Both also omit the DOWEC-derived context values (0.35 MW loss at ~6.25 MW aerodynamic power, 5,025,500 kg·m² low-speed-shaft equivalent inertia) and the driveshaft natural-frequency statement (no numeric value given), which is acceptable since those are reference-machine figures or lack values. Set B's 'Region 3' condition is a clear hallucination not present in the text layer or image.
